one_sentence: This document presents a visual sketch tool for generating and downloading Theophysics blackboard diagrams.
executive_summary: This document describes a web-based tool called 'Theophysics Blackboard' that allows users to generate, customize, and download visual sketches of Theophysics concepts. The tool provides a template with optional title and subtitle fields, supports retina-ready PNG downloads at 1800x1040px, and includes a 'Redraw' button for fresh sketch variations. It is intended as a visual explainer to support core articles and broader context within the Theophysics Research Initiative.
short_summary: This document is a description of a visual sketch tool for Theophysics. The core claim is that the tool enables generation and download of customizable blackboard-style diagrams. Key evidence includes the template fields, redraw functionality, and PNG download options. This matters because it provides a visual communication medium for Theophysics concepts.
